rows.remaining: This row proves the pinned DXC target progression and PSO linking for the synthetic corpus; it does not claim exhaustive opcode or stage coverage.

The exact semantic readback set covers arithmetic, hyperbolic/normal math, msad4, SM6.4 dot2add and signed/unsigned dot4add packed accumulation, buffers, barriers, wave/quad operations, SM6.7 vector/int64 arithmetic, SM6.8 wide arithmetic, and SM6.9 float16 conversion.

The source-staged control-flow cases cover a multi-block switch, PHI merge, loop-carried aggregate state, vector aggregate extraction, and exact four-lane readback; nested-control and broader aggregate forms remain in the exhaustive row.

The parser now resolves LLVM vector element type references without self-recursion and the SM6.7/6.8 vector lanes remain exact; first-class LLVM array values and broader matrix/type lowering remain in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged atomic matrix exercises add, and, or, xor, signed/unsigned min/max, and exchange with exact old/new-value readback; 64-bit atomic resource-class breadth remains in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged vector lane proves a four-component shuffle and aggregate arithmetic across four dispatch lanes; broader vector comparisons, inserts, matrices, and aggregate memory forms remain in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged lane proves the selected double arithmetic expression through exact integer readback; broader double precision, make/split, bitcast, and capability semantics remain in the exhaustive row.
Unsupported semantics are rejected instead of being promoted through placeholder MSL; implementation breadth remains tracked by the open exhaustive row.
Single external-counter compute append/consume plus vertex/pixel append semantics are exact; multi-counter, directly indexed counter heaps, and other graphics stages remain fail-closed.

The focused runtime proves compute append values 100..103 with counter 4, consume values 200..203 with counter 0, vertex append values 10..12 with counter 3, and pixel append values 0..3 with counter 4. Multi-counter, dynamically indexed counter-heap, and other graphics-stage forms remain in the exhaustive row.
The corpus links one counter UAV and rejects a two-counter shader with E_FAIL; directly indexed counter heaps and non-vertex/pixel graphics-stage counters remain fail-closed.

Memory and disk-session key/value semantics, size queries, replacement, limits, and missing-key errors plus executable stored-compute-pipeline recreation are covered; complete compiler-factory/state-database behavior remains in the exhaustive row.

The focused matrix covers the current SM6.6/6.7 atomic, descriptor, texture, static and programmable offset, typed-texture, sample-compare, raw-gather, QuadVote, root-constant provider, and SM6.8 SampleCmpGrad/SampleCmpBias cases; complete SM5.x–SM6.9 opcode/stage/resource coverage remains open.
The audit covers reports emitted by the focused invocation; it is not an exhaustive title corpus.

The source-staged matrix proves exact sample/load, GetDimensions, and readback for 1D, 1D-array, 2D, 2D-array, 3D, cube, cube-array, and 2D MSAA textures plus UAV stores for 1D/1D-array/2D/2D-array/3D. Height-one Metal 2D backing additionally proves nonzero 1D/1D-array mips; MSAA UAV stores and broader operation coverage remain tracked separately.

Mip-1 scalar/array 1D sampling and GetDimensions pass over height-one Metal 2D backing; a combined level/bias/gradient/static-offset lane returns 0x14323232; all standard min/mag/mip and anisotropic filters return exact values; clamp/wrap/mirror/border/mirror-once and the three Metal-representable border colors return exact values; unrepresentable dynamic-border and min/max reduction samplers remain fail-closed with the exact 0xdeadbeef sentinel; and the resource matrix creates a five-mip 1D array without a Metal assertion. Full depth-comparison filtering remains in the exhaustive row.

The source-staged R32_UINT Texture2D<uint> Load/GetDimensions case proves metadata element type propagation into an integer Metal texture view; the expanded typed-family row covers signed, writable, normalized, packed 10/11-bit, and scalar 64-bit breadth while multisample writable forms remain exhaustive work.

The focused source-staged matrix proves R32_SINT and R32_UINT read views plus an R32_UINT writable view with exact readback; R16/RG16/RGBA8, normalized/packed, and scalar 64-bit breadth is covered by the expanded row while MSAA-UAV forms remain exhaustive work.

The 42-case source-staged matrix proves R32/R16/RG16/RGBA8 signed, unsigned, floating, and normalized access; packed R10G10B10A2 UINT/UNORM and R11G11B10 FLOAT; and scalar signed/unsigned 64-bit R32G32_UINT reads/writes with exact logical or storage-bit readback. Multisample writable families remain in the exhaustive row.

Positive and negative evidence is still incomplete for the full stable SM5.x-DXBC through SM6.9-DXIL opcode/intrinsic, graphics-stage, texture-dimension, multi-counter/direct-counter-heap, cache, and compiler-session matrix.
